name: bugs
description: Produces from an informal defect description a structured five-field bug report: title, steps to reproduce, expected vs actual, severity with justification, and suggested fix location. Read-only by default: it emits the report and never edits code, opens a PR, or files an issue on its own.

output_dir.title: Output directory
output_dir.description: Where --file writes reports. When unset, reports go to the plugin's own persistent data directory. Set this to a path in your repository if you want bug reports committed alongside your code.

gotchas_file.title: Personal gotchas file
gotchas_file.description: A Markdown file of your own whose ## Gotchas section /bugs:scan and /bugs:write read in every repository, before the team and personal override layers. Replaces ~/.claude/bugs.md, which /bugs:setup apply moves here.
